_meta.deed_formats: Tri-State county layers: DEED_BOOK / DEED_PAGE as separate text fields (blank = single space); some counties fill deeds on only part of the roll (Covington, Humphreys, Pontotoc, Jefferson Davis, Lafayette, Walthall, Union, Pike) and Tippah/Rankin(CMPDD) are all blank. MDEQ-schema layers (statewide, GTPDD Tallahatchie/Yalobusha): DEEDREF packs book and page as "BOOK - PAGE" (e.g. "0201 - 7816", "16-H - 353", "BK 1056  - PG 587"); placeholder "-" means none; some counties are year + instrument ("2021-0002631-D-J2" Harrison, "20221 - 990" Yalobusha, "- 63688" Itawamba). Split on " - " for DB/PG. GTPDD Clay uses DEED_REF.
_meta.plat_formats: Plat references are rare: Lincoln plat_ref (2,804), Warren PLAT_REF (11,511), Pike platref (4); statewide PLATREF is mostly blank. Most Tri-State layers carry only SUB_NAME.
_meta.excluded_false_hits: Greene_Service (nJbIFHiSnaX0z0hS, EPSG 2264) sample fell outside Mississippi (another state's Greene County); Waggoner Engineering "Parcels_MS Statewide 2022" is an older private copy of the statewide layer; MS_Coastal_County_Parcels (MDMR) requires a token; ParcelsBraswell_Franklin (multi-county third-party extract).

status_legend.ok: owner+deed+PID live-verified countywide, deed filled on at least 50% of parcels
status_legend.partial: owner+PID with no deed field, deed filled on under 50% of parcels, or a third-party/statewide copy without deed
